sql: SELECT topic(1) AS secadero, ts, temperatura, humedad, floor(timestamp() / 1000) AS recibido FROM '+/lecturas' WHERE ts > 1700000000 AND temperatura >= -40 AND temperatura <= 80 AND humedad >= 0 AND humedad <= 100
description: Guarda cada lectura del ESP32 en DynamoDB (tabla cocatrace_lecturas)
